newsitem.title: GERMANY: Yeltsin to visit Germany in April, Bonn says.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to visit Germany in April, Bonn says.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will visit Germany on April 17 and 18 for talks with Chancellor Helmut Kohl, a German government spokesman said on Friday.

He said Kohl would raise the subject of German art treasures seized by the Red Army after World War Two but added it was not clear if the issue would still be topical in April and thus be likely to form part of the talks.
The Russian parliament approved a draft law on Wednesday handing ownership of the treasures to Russia.
Yeltsin will receive an annual award bestowed by German newspaper editors for outstanding international personalities during his visit.
